path='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u052/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e93dab81.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j] == 8 or (i, j) in seen:
                continue
            q = [(i, j)]
            seen.add((i, j))
            comp = []
            for a, b in q:
                comp.append((a, b))
                for x, y in ((a+1,b), (a-1,b), (a,b+1), (a,b-1)):
                    if 0 <= x < h and 0 <= y < w and grid[x][y] != 8 and (x,y) not in seen:
                        seen.add((x,y))
                        q.append((x,y))
            colored = [(a,b) for a,b in comp if grid[a][b] not in (0,8)]
            if not colored:
                continue
            pr0, pr1 = min(a for a,b in colored), max(a for a,b in colored)
            pc0, pc1 = min(b for a,b in colored), max(b for a,b in colored)
            pat = [[grid[a][b] for b in range(pc0,pc1+1)] for a in range(pr0,pr1+1)]
            for a,b in comp:
                out[a][b] = pat[(a-pr0) % len(pat)][(b-pc0) % len(pat[0])]
    return out
'''
